summary: Frontend-only mobile responsiveness verification at 390x844 (real 390px viewport). PASSED: desktop nav is correctly hidden (nav-lobby/nav-vip/nav-leaderboard present but not visible), hamburger [data-testid=nav-mobile-menu] visible for logged-out users and its Ops Lobby / VIP Ranks / Leaderboard items navigate correctly; logged-in compact header (mute + 10,000 balance chip + avatar) fits with ZERO header overflow (header h=66px, no element beyond 390px); logged-in avatar dropdown exposes Ops Lobby / VIP Ranks / Leaderboard (lg:hidden) + Wallet + Cashier and Cashier navigates to /cashier; no document horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390) on /, /lobby, /slots/desert_fury, /slots/sweet_ammo and /cashier; trailer video fits (x=18 w=354) and hero title/badges/CTAs are not clipped; flagship intro CONTINUE TO PLAY is in-viewport and horizontally centered (x=74 w=243); flagship mobile SPIN bar is centered (x=35, right=355) and a real spin works on mobile (balance 10,000 -> 9,900); lobby tile tap navigates to the game; Cashier card-deposit form (amount/currency/submit) is usable at 390px. BLOCKER FOUND: the ENLIST/Login dialog renders ~8k-40k px BELOW the viewport on every page, so a real mobile user tapping ENLIST sees only a black overlay and cannot register or log in (Playwright only worked because it auto-scrolls). Registered 2 fresh accounts for logged-in checks.

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKER: the modal is not fixed-positioned. Computed style on [role=dialog] is position:relative with top:4510px (Landing) / top:~19.8k px (Lobby), so its getBoundingClientRect().y is 8233 on / and 39569 on /lobby while window.scrollY=0 (viewport height 844). Root cause: AuthDialog passes className="hud hud-gold ..." and index.css:116 `.hud { position: relative; }` overrides Tailwind's `fixed left-[50%] top-[50%]` utility on DialogContent, so top:50% resolves against the whole document height. Radix also locks body scroll, so the user sees only the dim overlay with no dialog and no way to reach it (verified by screenshot on /lobby). Registration/login is unreachable for real users on mobile AND desktop. Fix: drop the `hud` class from DialogContent (use a wrapper div inside), or add `position: fixed` back / scope `.hud` so it cannot win over the utility.

No Login entry at 390px: [data-testid=nav-login-btn] is `hidden sm:inline-flex` and the hamburger menu only contains Ops Lobby / VIP Ranks / Leaderboard. A returning mobile user must tap ENLIST and then 'Already enlisted? Sign in'. Add a Login item to the mobile menu.

action_items: P0 - Remove/neutralise the `hud` class on AuthDialog's DialogContent (or restore position:fixed). `.hud{position:relative}` in index.css beats Tailwind's `fixed`, pushing the login/register modal thousands of px below the fold on every page. Nobody can sign up or sign in without manual scrolling. Verify by clicking ENLIST and screenshotting WITHOUT scrolling.
P1 - Add a 'Login' item to the mobile hamburger menu (nav-login-btn is hidden under sm).
P1 - Centre [data-testid="slot-spin-mobile"] the same way as the flagship bar (w-full max-w-xs mx-auto) and stop the BALANCE label from squeezing it.
P2 - Fix the '$$' double dollar in Cashier.jsx limits line and round FX limits.
P2 - Keep the flagship sticky-bar BALANCE label from clipping at the viewport bottom (add padding / smaller line-height).
P3 - Replace the native currency <select> with the shadcn Select for mobile-friendly picking.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css `.hud { position: relative; }` is a global class that silently overrides Tailwind positioning utilities wherever it is combined with `fixed`/`absolute`. AuthDialog is the current victim; audit all other `hud` usages that also rely on utility positioning, and prefer wrapping the styled surface in an inner div instead of applying `hud` to Radix Content nodes.
Mobile nav parity: logged-out mobile users get Ops Lobby/VIP/Leaderboard but no Login; logged-in users get the full set. Keep both menus generated from one NAV_ITEMS array to avoid drift.
SlotGame.jsx mobile bar and FlagshipSlot.jsx mobile bar duplicate the same sticky-footer markup with divergent centring; extract a shared <MobileSpinBar/> component.

rca_of_the_issue: AuthDialog renders <DialogContent className="hud hud-gold ...">. Radix's DialogContent ships Tailwind `fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%]`. index.css defines `.hud { position: relative; }` outside Tailwind's utilities layer, so it wins the cascade and the element becomes position:relative. `top:50%` then resolves against the offset parent's (document body's) height, giving top:4510px on Landing (doc 9020px) and ~19.8k px on Lobby (doc 40356px); measured getBoundingClientRect().y = 8233 and 39569 respectively with scrollY=0 and viewport height 844. Repro: open / or /lobby at 390x844, tap [data-testid=nav-enlist-btn], do not scroll - only the dim overlay is visible. Mitigation: remove `hud` from the DialogContent className (apply it to an inner wrapper) or append `fixed` via a higher-specificity rule.
